name: Mango & Passion
description: Thynkers Lyquid Mango & Passion is a Gotukola-infused drink with ripe mango and passion fruit flavour, crafted in Sri Lanka to support clear thinking and mindful energy.
tagline: Bold in Taste. Made to Inspire.
summary: Sweet mango and vibrant passion fruit, blended with our signature gotu kola infusion.
story: Sweet mango meets the vibrant character of passion fruit. Our signature gotu kola infusion is blended with bold, juicy tropical flavours for a refreshing everyday moment.
finish: Powered by gotu kola. Flavored with mango & passion fruit.
ingredients: Carbonated water, Gotu Kola Extract, Citric Acid (INS 330), Mango Natural Flavour, Passion Natural Flavour, L-Theanine, Vitamin B12.
